{{Quote|A Delta-Seven pilot would usually use an Arthree-Dee. It's better at keeping the guns targeted, and the fighter is so maneuverable that handling the laser cannons is tricky.''"<br />"''[&hellip;]''"<br />"''Suppose the pilot didn't need the extra gunnery skills of an Arthree-Dee? Would an Arfour-Pea then be a better choice?''"<br />"''Yes.''"<br />"''And what pilot wouldn't need the extra droid gunnery skills?''"<br />"''You!|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] compare the R4-P and R3-D|<ref name="Novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''R3-D (Arthree-Dee)'''<ref name="Novelization" /> was a variant of the [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]]<ref name="R3-D droid" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="R series astromech droids" /> that aided in target acquisition and management.<ref name="R3-D droid" /> They were hardwired into [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]<ref name="TNEGtV&V">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="R3-D droid" /> as the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were so maneuverable that handling their [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] was difficult. However, those who did not require the R3-D's extra gunnery skills, such as members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], instead preferred the superior [[Navigator/Legends|navigation]] capabilities of the [[R4-P astromech droid|R4-P]].<ref name="Novelization" />
